test_title: PYST 17: Selection Post (GraduatiOn Level) - English (Held On 28 June, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the grammatically correct sentence.

A.I would like to spend an evening near pool with a cup of coffee.

B.I would like to spend an evening near pool with cup of coffee.

C.I would like to spend a evening near a pool with a cup of coffee.

D.I would like to spend an evening near a pool with a cup of coffee.
solution:
The correct answer is** "D".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is grammatically correct, using articles "a" appropriately before both "pool" and "cup".
 
• "Near a pool" specifies a single, unspecified pool, making "a" necessary for clarity.
 
• "With a cup of coffee" correctly specifies the accompaniment, using "a" to denote one cup.
 
• The sentence structure follows conventional English syntax for expressing desires or hypothetical situations.

**Therefore, the correct answer is "Option 2". **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Options 1) C and 3) B lack the necessary articles, making them grammatically incorrect.
 
• Option 4) A incorrectly omits the article before "pool" and makes the same mistake as in B.
